prayers.name: Oath of Restoration
prayers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **^^Duardin Ascendant^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they have any models contesting the target. If the chanting roll was 7+, friendly **^^Duardin Ascendant^^** models have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they have any models contesting the target instead.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Duardin Ascendant Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible objective within 18" of them that is coned by 2 or more friendly **unified** units to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Spirit of the White Dwarf
prayers.effect: The target is **unified** until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Duardin Ascendant Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Duardin Ascendant^^** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
